# ztna_connector (Data Source)

Connector data source



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the connector.

It can only be 64 characters long
and contain unicode text, space, dash, or underscore, or period.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) Created time
- `description` (String) Description of the connector.
- `group` (String) The connector group id
- `oid` (String) Id of the entry.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `updated_time` (String) Updated time
